notes.title: Dark Gravity Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Hello Dear Fans,

Patch 1.01 has just been released, here you can see a list of all the fixes implemented, based on your feedback. Thanks for playing our game and we hope you will continue enjoying it.

What has been fixed:

 Scrolling script on missions (sometimes camera was stopping at incorrect positions making missions impossible to finish)
 Aoe slowing and jamming attacks were affecting player incorrectly
 Archalien boss had wrong collision setup
 Fossil boss laser rotating attack had too high speed
 Deselecting additional weapons in hangar by removing weapon slot upgrade was not removing weapon model from the fighter (bug not affecting gameplay and occuring only in menu)



Best,
GamePlanet

notes.title: "Dark Gravity Prologue" is available now - for Free!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36457654/baebfa1e510bfb92bfdf330a91ad0d7b37f87c47.png

Grab your controller, fellow gamers! Today, we're announcing the arrival of an epic moment we've all been waiting for - the premiere of a game that will change the rules of the game! Welcome to the world of "Dark Gravity Prologue," where action is at your fingertips, and gameplay is pure magic.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1776590/Dark_Gravity_Prologue/

What's "Dark Gravity Prologue" all about?

"Dark Gravity Prologue" is a real treat for gamers seeking a slightly different adventure. You'll step into the shoes of a character whose gravity-manipulating abilities open the doors to incredible challenges. Jump, float, and explore an extraordinary land filled with mysterious mazes and foes you'll need to conquer.

Why should you play "Dark Gravity Prologue" now?

You're probably wondering. Well, we've got some good news for you - "Dark Gravity Prologue" is available for free! Yes, you heard it right, this fantastic game is now accessible for you to try at no cost. It's a unique opportunity to experience gameplay that will stay with you for a long time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36457654/985578c7c168d648fabf8af76e3a78634b88a4a5.png

Get ready for the adventure!

If you're up for the challenge, there's nothing left to do but head to the "Dark Gravity Prologue" page on Steam and immerse yourself in this fascinating journey. Great possibilities, mysteries, and unpredictable moments await you - and all for free! Join other gamers and let yourself be drawn into the dark magnetism of "Dark Gravity Prologue."

Plan your journey now!

Wishing you an exciting gameplay and unforgettable moments in the world of "Dark Gravity Prologue!"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36457654/439c17e9fda82f282a8bb9667d21dc4dff98b205.png

notes.title: Dark Gravity Steam NEXT Livestream
notes.content:
Hello Pilots

We are extremely happy to welcome you, to our Steam NEXT livestream.

We hope you will enjoy our show and also the ability to talk with our developers. 
We are super excited that you will all finally have a chance to play our game for yourselves.
Remember to leave us feedback and questions regarding the game, either during our livestream where our team will be available to chat with you and answer all your questions, as well as on Discussion Tab of our Steam Page. 

Be sure to download our demo and leave a review with your thoughts on it. Also remember to Add Dark Gravity to your Steam Wishlist so that you will be informed as soon as we post any new info regarding our game. 

Thanks for being with us and we hope you will enjoy this Steam NEXT show that we have prepared for you.
